Name: Crate and Barrel
Author: fruitipebbles
Description:
[font=Courier New]Adds 4 crates and 8 barrels (small and large) to the game.

[b]installation:[/b]

Requires: SMAPI & [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url].
Recommended: [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/93]CJB Item Spawner[/url]
Put it in your mods folder.[b]
[/b]
You can spawn in the crates and barrels via CJB or using the furniture catalogue as usual.
